top_signals.title: Canada Exports to US Surged in August Ahead of New Tariffs
top_signals.summary: Canadian exports to the US rose sharply in August as importers appeared to rush to get ahead of new tariffs imposed by the Trump administration toward the end of the month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Pimco Touts Diversification Need as Yields Lure at 24-Year High
top_signals.summary: Pacific Investment Management Co. says bond yields at multi-decade highs offer attractive income for investors, who should spread their allocations across developed and emerging markets to help protect against fiscal risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Trade Gap Widens to $105.6 Billion as Imports Hit Record
top_signals.summary: The US trade deficit widened sharply in August to the largest since early 2025 as a surge in inbound shipments of capital goods helped push imports to a record.

top_signals.summary: Several mysteries surround what appeared to be an unauthorized push notification sent to customers of London-based clothing company ASOS.
